title: Cooperative
subtitle: 協作的；合作完成工作的
description: 協作的；合作完成工作的

words.meaning: 協作的；合作完成工作的
words.note: 當 cooperative 強調幾個人或團隊共同規劃、分享想法並一起完成工作時，可用 collaborative。它比 cooperative 更直接突出『共同創作／共同工作』。
words.example: The project succeeded because the team used a highly collaborative approach.
words.exampleZh: 這個項目成功，是因為團隊採用了高度協作的方式。

exercises.original: The department wants a more cooperative approach in which designers, engineers, and researchers make decisions together.
exercises.zh: 部門希望採用更協作的方式，讓設計師、工程師和研究員共同作決定。
exercises.upgrade: collaborative · 協作的；合作完成工作的

options.explanation: obedient = 順從的。表示服從命令，不是多方共同決策。
collaborative = 協作的。designers, engineers, researchers make decisions together 是典型共同工作。
passive = 被動的。和主動協作相反。
friendly = 友善的。友善不等於共同完成工作。
compliant = 遵從要求的。強調服從規則，不是共同創作。
independent = 獨立的。和 together 明顯相反。

exercises.original: The new research programme is deliberately cooperative, with three universities sharing data and writing papers together.
exercises.zh: 新的研究計劃刻意採用協作模式，三所大學共享資料並共同撰寫論文。
exercises.upgrade: collaborative · 協作的；合作完成工作的

options.explanation: helpful only = 只是樂於幫忙。不能完整表達三所大學共同研究。
supportive only = 只是支持。支持不一定共同做研究。
obedient = 順從。不是機構合作。
team-friendly = 可理解但不是標準精準詞。
collaborative = 協作的。sharing data + writing papers together 是決定性線索。
passive = 被動。語義相反。

exercises.original: The workshop used a cooperative process: participants built one proposal together rather than submitting separate ideas.
exercises.zh: 工作坊採用協作流程：參加者共同建立一份提案，而不是各自提交想法。
exercises.upgrade: collaborative · 協作的；合作完成工作的

options.explanation: collaborative = 協作的。one proposal together 是非常清楚的共同產出。
compliant = 遵從的。不是流程的共同創作性。
friendly = 友善。不是工作方式。
agreeable = 令人愉快／願意同意。意思不夠精準。
docile = 溫順的。通常形容容易控制的人或動物。
independent = 獨立的。和 rather than separate ideas 的語意相反。

words.note: 當 cooperative 的重點是某人願意提供資訊、協助或實際幫忙，使事情更順利時，可用 helpful。它不一定表示雙方共同工作，因此只在『願意幫忙』語境最接近。
words.example: The receptionist was helpful and answered all our questions.
words.exampleZh: 接待員很樂於幫忙，回答了我們所有問題。

exercises.original: The witness was very cooperative and answered every question clearly, which made the investigation easier.
exercises.zh: 證人非常合作，清楚回答每個問題，令調查更容易。
exercises.upgrade: helpful · 樂於幫忙的；有幫助的

options.explanation: obedient = 順從。證人不是因服從權威才必然有幫助。
friendly = 友善。可以友善但不提供有效資訊。
passive = 被動。不能解釋清楚回答問題。
helpful = 樂於幫忙的。answered every question clearly + made investigation easier 是直接線索。
compliant = 遵從的。可能配合程序，但不如 helpful 表示實際協助。
silent = 沉默的。和 answered every question 相反。

exercises.original: The hotel staff were cooperative when our booking was wrong and quickly found us another room.
exercises.zh: 預訂出錯時，酒店職員很樂於幫忙，很快替我們找到另一間房。
exercises.upgrade: helpful · 樂於幫忙的；有幫助的

options.explanation: passive = 被動。和 quickly found another room 相反。
supportive = 支持的。可接近，但實際解決問題更自然說 helpful。
helpful = 樂於幫忙的。quickly found us another room 是典型服務協助。
obedient = 順從。不是服務語境的核心。
docile = 溫順。對酒店職員不自然。
strict = 嚴格。無關。

exercises.original: The librarian was cooperative and showed me exactly where to find the archived newspapers.
exercises.zh: 圖書館員很樂於幫忙，準確告訴我在哪裡找舊報紙。
exercises.upgrade: helpful · 樂於幫忙的；有幫助的

options.explanation: compliant = 遵從。沒有規則服從線索。
quiet = 安靜。不是協助。
passive = 被動。和主動指引相反。
obedient = 順從。無關。
uncritical = 不加批判的。無關。
helpful = 有幫助的。showed exactly where to find something 是標準服務協助。

words.meaning: 願意合作的；願意配合的
words.note: willing to cooperate 是 cooperative 很直接的解釋性改寫，特別適合調查、談判、工作安排或需要某人主動配合的語境。
words.example: The company said it was willing to cooperate with the investigation.
words.exampleZh: 公司表示願意配合調查。

exercises.original: The suspect was cooperative with investigators and agreed to provide the requested records.
exercises.zh: 疑犯願意配合調查人員，並同意提供所要求的紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: willing to cooperate · 願意合作的；願意配合的

options.explanation: willing to cooperate = 願意配合。agreed to provide records 是直接合作行為。
obedient = 順從。可能暗示權威服從，不等於自願配合。
passive = 被動。不能解釋主動同意提供資料。
friendly = 友善。不一定配合調查。
helpful only = 有幫助。接近，但題目特別是 formal cooperation with investigators。
submissive = 順服的。語氣過強且帶權力關係。

exercises.original: The union remained cooperative during the talks and continued meeting management despite major disagreements.
exercises.zh: 工會在會談期間仍願意合作，即使有重大分歧也繼續與管理層會面。
exercises.upgrade: willing to cooperate · 願意合作的；願意配合的

options.explanation: friendly = 友善。雙方可以不友善但仍繼續談判。
passive = 被動。不合持續會談。
obedient = 順從。工會和管理層不是服從關係。
willing to cooperate = 願意合作。continued meeting despite disagreements 是最清楚線索。
compliant = 遵從要求。會淡化平等談判關係。
unquestioning = 不加質疑的。和 major disagreements 相反。

exercises.original: Both departments were cooperative and agreed to share staff during the busiest month.
exercises.zh: 兩個部門都願意合作，同意在最繁忙月份共享人手。
exercises.upgrade: willing to cooperate · 願意合作的；願意配合的

options.explanation: supportive = 支持的。接近，但 agreed to share staff 更直接是合作意願。
friendly = 友善。不是資源共享。
willing to cooperate = 願意合作。agreed to share staff 是明確合作行動。
passive = 被動。相反。
obedient = 順從。兩個部門不是上下服從。
docile = 溫順。對部門不自然。

words.meaning: 通融的；願意配合他人需要的
words.note: 當 cooperative 強調某人願意調整安排、作出讓步或配合別人的實際需要時，可用 accommodating。它比 helpful 更突出『願意遷就／調整』。
words.example: The manager was accommodating and changed the meeting time for us.
words.exampleZh: 經理很通融，替我們更改了會議時間。

exercises.original: The landlord was cooperative about our moving date and allowed us to stay two extra days.
exercises.zh: 業主在搬遷日期方面很通融，讓我們多住兩天。
exercises.upgrade: accommodating · 通融的；願意配合他人需要的

options.explanation: strict = 嚴格。和 extra two days 相反。
obedient = 順從。業主不是服從租客。
helpful only = 有幫助。接近，但 changing/relaxing arrangements 更精準是 accommodating。
passive = 被動。不是主動通融。
accommodating = 通融的。allowed us to stay extra days 是典型配合別人需要。
compliant = 遵從規定。這裡反而是放寬安排。

exercises.original: The venue staff were cooperative and moved the event to a quieter room after we explained the problem.
exercises.zh: 我們解釋問題後，場地職員很配合，把活動移到較安靜的房間。
exercises.upgrade: accommodating · 通融的；願意配合他人需要的

options.explanation: accommodating = 願意配合需要。moved the event after request 是典型調整安排。
submissive = 順服。語氣過強。
obedient = 服從命令。不是服務配合。
passive = 被動。相反。
uncritical = 不加批判。無關。
rigid = 僵化、不通融。和題意相反。

exercises.original: Our host was cooperative about dietary requirements and prepared a separate meal for one guest.
exercises.zh: 主人很願意配合飲食需要，為其中一位客人另外準備餐點。
exercises.upgrade: accommodating · 通融的；願意配合他人需要的

options.explanation: friendly = 友善。友善不一定願意改菜單。
supportive = 支持。沒有調整安排的精準意思。
compliant = 遵從規定。dietary request 不是權威要求。
accommodating = 通融配合。prepared a separate meal 是明確調整以滿足需要。
passive = 被動。相反。
obedient = 順從。語境不合。

words.meaning: 支持的；給予協助與鼓勵的
words.note: 當 cooperative 的重點是願意支持別人的工作、決定或努力，提供幫助而不是阻礙，可用 supportive。它常帶鼓勵、後援和正面態度。
words.example: Her colleagues were supportive during the difficult transition.
words.exampleZh: 在困難的過渡期，她的同事都很支持她。

exercises.original: Her colleagues were cooperative when she proposed the new mentoring scheme and offered to help run it.
exercises.zh: 她提出新的導師計劃時，同事都很支持，還主動提出協助推行。
exercises.upgrade: supportive · 支持的；給予協助與鼓勵的

options.explanation: passive = 被動。和 offered to help 相反。
supportive = 支持的。backed the proposal + offered help 是典型。
obedient = 順從。沒有命令關係。
compliant = 遵從要求。不是政策服從。
docile = 溫順。對專業同事不自然。
neutral = 中立。和主動支持相反。

exercises.original: The board was cooperative toward the community project and approved extra staff time for it.
exercises.zh: 董事會對社區項目很支持，並批准額外員工時間。
exercises.upgrade: supportive · 支持的；給予協助與鼓勵的

options.explanation: supportive = 支持的。approved extra staff time 表示實際後援。
friendly only = 只是友善。沒有資源支持意思。
passive = 被動。和 approved resources 相反。
obedient = 順從。董事會不是被命令。
submissive = 順服。語氣不合。
unquestioning = 不加質疑。支持不等於不批判。

exercises.original: The school was cooperative with the student's return after illness and arranged extra tutoring.
exercises.zh: 學生病後復課時，學校非常支持，並安排額外輔導。
exercises.upgrade: supportive · 支持的；給予協助與鼓勵的

options.explanation: compliant = 遵從規定。沒有服從線索。
passive = 被動。和 arranged extra tutoring 相反。
friendly = 友善。不能表達實際支援。
helpful only = 有幫助。接近，但整體態度和資源後援更自然是 supportive。
supportive = 支持的。extra tutoring 是具體支援措施。
obedient = 順從。無關。

words.meaning: 重視團隊合作的；有團隊精神的
words.note: 當 cooperative 描述一個人的工作風格，表示他重視團隊目標、願意分享資訊並和同事一起做事，可用 team-oriented。它常見於職場和招聘語境。
words.example: We are looking for a team-oriented person who communicates well with colleagues.
words.exampleZh: 我們想找一位有團隊精神、善於和同事溝通的人。

exercises.original: The employer wants someone cooperative who shares information, helps colleagues, and puts team goals before personal credit.
exercises.zh: 僱主想找一位有團隊精神的人，願意分享資訊、幫助同事，並把團隊目標放在個人功勞之前。
exercises.upgrade: team-oriented · 重視團隊合作的；有團隊精神的

options.explanation: competitive = 好競爭的。可能重視個人成績，和 team goals 線索不符。
individualistic = 個人主義的。和分享、團隊目標相反。
obedient = 順從。不是團隊合作風格。
passive = 被動。不是主動幫助同事。
team-oriented = 重視團隊的。shares information + helps colleagues + team goals 是決定性線索。
compliant = 遵從。只能說服從要求，不能表達團隊精神。

exercises.original: She is cooperative by nature and prefers solving problems with colleagues rather than working alone.
exercises.zh: 她天生重視團隊合作，比起獨自工作，更喜歡和同事一起解決問題。
exercises.upgrade: team-oriented · 重視團隊合作的；有團隊精神的

options.explanation: team-oriented = 有團隊精神的。prefers working with colleagues rather than alone 是直接定義。
submissive = 順服。不是合作偏好。
compliant = 遵從。不是團隊取向。
passive = 被動。合作可很主動。
docile = 溫順。語氣不合專業工作。
agreeable = 隨和／令人愉快。可能容易相處，但不等於重視團隊目標。

exercises.original: The manager described him as cooperative because he always involves teammates and shares credit for success.
exercises.zh: 經理形容他很有團隊精神，因為他總會讓隊友參與，並分享成功的功勞。
exercises.upgrade: team-oriented · 重視團隊合作的；有團隊精神的

options.explanation: friendly = 友善。不能完整表達 involves teammates and shares credit。
team-oriented = 團隊導向。兩個線索都直接指向團隊精神。
obedient = 順從。無關。
helpful only = 只是有幫助。範圍太窄。
passive = 被動。相反。
uncritical = 不批判。不是合作能力。

words.meaning: 同事間合作融洽的；具同僚合作精神的
words.note: collegial 是較正式的職場／學術詞，形容同事之間互相尊重、平等交流、合作良好的氣氛或態度。它不像 friendly 那麼一般，而是專指專業同僚關係。
words.example: The department has a collegial culture in which staff freely share ideas.
words.exampleZh: 這個部門有良好的同僚合作文化，員工會自由分享想法。

exercises.original: The department has a cooperative atmosphere in which senior and junior staff openly share ideas and treat one another as professional equals.
exercises.zh: 部門有很好的同僚合作氣氛，資深和初級員工會公開分享想法，並以專業平等方式彼此相待。
exercises.upgrade: collegial · 同事間合作融洽的；具同僚合作精神的

options.explanation: obedient = 順從。和 professional equals 不符。
passive = 被動。不是互相交流。
compliant = 遵從要求。不是同僚關係。
collegial = 同僚合作融洽的。professional equals + share ideas 是典型。
submissive = 順服。和平等相反。
competitive = 競爭的。和合作氣氛不符。

exercises.original: The faculty is known for being cooperative, with professors regularly reviewing one another's work and sharing teaching materials.
exercises.zh: 這個學院以同僚合作風氣聞名，教授經常互評工作並分享教材。
exercises.upgrade: collegial · 同事間合作融洽的；具同僚合作精神的

options.explanation: friendly only = 只是友善。不能涵蓋專業互評和教材共享。
collegial = 同僚合作的。professors + peer review + sharing materials 是典型學術同僚文化。
obedient = 順從。不是平等專業關係。
passive = 被動。相反。
compliant = 遵從。語意不合。
docile = 溫順。對教授不自然。

exercises.original: She maintained a cooperative relationship with colleagues in other departments, even when they disagreed.
exercises.zh: 即使意見不同，她和其他部門同事仍保持良好的同僚合作關係。
exercises.upgrade: collegial · 同事間合作融洽的；具同僚合作精神的

options.explanation: collegial = 同僚合作融洽的。relationship with colleagues + disagreement but mutual professionalism 是典型。
submissive = 順服。不同意見並不表示服從。
obedient = 順從。不是同事平等關係。
passive = 被動。無法表達合作關係。
unquestioning = 不質疑。和 even when they disagreed 相反。
compliant = 遵從。不是同僚合作。

words.meaning: 建設性的；有助解決問題的
words.note: 當 cooperative 出現在討論、談判或處理衝突的語境，重點是雙方願意以有用、理性、能推進問題解決的方式合作時，可用 constructive。它不是所有 cooperative 的通用替換。
words.example: The two sides held a constructive discussion and agreed on several next steps.
words.exampleZh: 雙方進行了建設性的討論，並同意了幾個下一步。

exercises.original: The meeting remained cooperative even during disagreement, with both sides proposing practical compromises.
exercises.zh: 即使有分歧，會議仍很有建設性，雙方都提出實際折衷方案。
exercises.upgrade: constructive · 建設性的；有助解決問題的

options.explanation: passive = 被動。提出折衷方案是主動行為。
obedient = 順從。雙方並非上下關係。
constructive = 建設性的。practical compromises + disagreement 是典型問題解決語境。
friendly only = 只是友善。討論可以不友善但仍建設性。
compliant = 遵從。不是談判品質。
uncritical = 不加批判。constructive discussion 可以包含批評。

exercises.original: The union and management had a cooperative exchange and identified three workable solutions.
exercises.zh: 工會與管理層進行了建設性的交流，找出三個可行方案。
exercises.upgrade: constructive · 建設性的；有助解決問題的

options.explanation: constructive = 建設性的。identified workable solutions 是直接線索。
obedient = 順從。談判雙方不是服從關係。
passive = 被動。相反。
submissive = 順服。語氣不合。
agreeable only = 只是令人愉快／願意同意。不能保證產生解決方案。
compliant = 遵從要求。不是 exchange 的品質。

exercises.original: The conversation became more cooperative once everyone stopped blaming one another and focused on what could be changed.
exercises.zh: 大家停止互相指責、開始專注可改變之處後，對話變得更有建設性。
exercises.upgrade: constructive · 建設性的；有助解決問題的

options.explanation: friendly = 友善。可能仍有不同意見，重點不是友善程度。
passive = 被動。focused on change 是主動解決問題。
obedient = 順從。無關。
constructive = 建設性的。stopped blaming + focused on change 是典型。
docile = 溫順。對 conversation 不自然。
compliant = 遵從。不是對話品質。

words.meaning: 容易合作的；很好共事的
words.note: 當 cooperative 描述一個人整體上不難相處、願意溝通、願意配合工作安排時，口語中很自然可說 easy to work with。這個說法比 cooperative 更生活化。
words.example: She is organised, flexible, and easy to work with.
words.exampleZh: 她做事有條理、靈活，而且很好共事。

exercises.original: Everyone says the new designer is cooperative: she communicates clearly, accepts feedback, and rarely creates unnecessary conflict.
exercises.zh: 大家都說新設計師很好共事：她溝通清楚、接受意見，而且很少製造不必要衝突。
exercises.upgrade: easy to work with · 容易合作的；很好共事的

options.explanation: obedient = 順從。接受 feedback 不等於無條件服從。
easy to work with = 好共事的。clear communication + accepts feedback + little conflict 是典型。
passive = 被動。不是好合作的必要特徵。
compliant = 遵從。語氣太像服從規則。
docile = 溫順。帶可控制意味，不適合專業評價。
uncritical = 不批判。好共事的人仍可提出不同意見。

exercises.original: The contractor was cooperative throughout the renovation, responding quickly and discussing changes calmly.
exercises.zh: 整個翻新工程中，承辦商都很好共事，回覆快速，也會平靜討論改動。
exercises.upgrade: easy to work with · 容易合作的；很好共事的

options.explanation: friendly only = 只是友善。不能完整涵蓋 responsiveness 和 calm discussion。
easy to work with = 好共事的。整體合作體驗正是題目重點。
obedient = 順從。承辦商不是被命令。
passive = 被動。responding quickly 不合。
submissive = 順服。語氣過強。
compliant = 遵從規定。範圍太窄。

exercises.original: She is highly cooperative in group projects and handles disagreements without making things personal.
exercises.zh: 她在小組項目中很好共事，處理分歧時不會把事情個人化。
exercises.upgrade: easy to work with · 容易合作的；很好共事的

options.explanation: easy to work with = 好共事的。handles disagreements professionally 是典型合作品質。
compliant = 遵從。合作不等於凡事同意。
obedient = 順從。不是團隊平等關係。
passive = 被動。無法表達健康處理分歧。
unquestioning = 不加質疑。和 disagreements 的健康處理不同。
docile = 溫順。帶負面權力語感。

words.meaning: 願意接受建議／安排的；願意合作的（較正式）
words.note: 當 cooperative 表示某人對建議、安排、改變或討論持開放態度、願意接受，可用較正式的 amenable，常見結構是 amenable to + noun / -ing。
words.example: The team was amenable to changing the schedule.
words.exampleZh: 團隊願意接受更改時間表。

exercises.original: The client was cooperative about revising the timetable and said she was open to moving the launch date.
exercises.zh: 客戶願意配合修改時間表，表示可以考慮更改推出日期。
exercises.upgrade: amenable · 願意接受建議／安排的；願意合作的（較正式）

options.explanation: passive = 被動。open to changing 是主動接受可能性。
obedient = 順從。不是服從命令。
compliant = 遵從要求。可接近但更像守規則。
rigid = 僵化。和 open to moving 相反。
amenable = 願意接受的。amenable to revising + open to moving 是典型。
docile = 溫順。對客戶語氣不合。

exercises.original: Management appeared cooperative toward the proposal and was willing to discuss several changes.
exercises.zh: 管理層對提案態度開放，願意討論幾項改動。
exercises.upgrade: amenable · 願意接受建議／安排的；願意合作的（較正式）

options.explanation: amenable = 願意接受／討論的。willing to discuss changes 是直接線索。
submissive = 順服。管理層不是服從他人。
passive = 被動。願意討論不是被動。
obedient = 順從。無關。
unquestioning = 不加質疑。討論改動不等於不質疑。
docile = 溫順。對管理層不自然。

exercises.original: The landlord seemed cooperative with the idea of renewing the lease on slightly different terms.
exercises.zh: 業主似乎願意接受以稍有不同的條款續租。
exercises.upgrade: amenable · 願意接受建議／安排的；願意合作的（較正式）

options.explanation: friendly = 友善。友善不代表接受新條款。
helpful = 有幫助。可能協助，但不等於願意接受 proposal。
amenable = 願意接受。amenable to the idea/terms 是自然正式搭配。
passive = 被動。不是態度開放。
obedient = 順從。業主不是服從租客。
compliant = 遵從規則。不是談判中接受不同條款。

falseSynonyms.zh: 順從要求的；合規的不等於一般的 cooperative compliant 強調遵從規則、要求或權威；cooperative 可以包含討論、互相調整和共同決策，不必是服從。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A compliant person follows requirements; a cooperative person works with others.

falseSynonyms.zh: 服從的；聽話的不等於一般的 cooperative obedient 強調服從命令或權威，常有上下關係；cooperative 可以是平等雙方自願合作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Obedience is about following orders; cooperation is about working together.

falseSynonyms.zh: 順服的；屈從的不等於一般的 cooperative submissive 帶有放棄主張、屈從於他人的意味，比 cooperative 負面且權力不對等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A cooperative person can disagree; a submissive person yields.

falseSynonyms.zh: 溫順的；容易控制的不等於一般的 cooperative docile 常形容容易管理、控制的人或動物；它不等於有團隊精神或主動合作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Docile means easy to control, not necessarily collaborative.

falseSynonyms.zh: 友善的不等於一般的 cooperative friendly 只表示態度友好。某人可以很友善卻不願分享資訊、作出讓步或共同工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Friendly behaviour does not necessarily mean cooperative behaviour.

falseSynonyms.zh: 被動的不等於一般的 cooperative passive 表示不主動行動；真正的 cooperative 往往需要主動溝通、協助和參與。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cooperation is often active; passivity is not.

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人愉快的；願意同意的不等於一般的 cooperative agreeable 有時可指容易相處或願意接受，但也常只是『令人愉快』，範圍和 cooperative 不完全相同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Agreeable can mean pleasant or willing, but it does not always imply cooperation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不加質疑的不等於一般的 cooperative unquestioning 表示不提出疑問或反對；合作的人完全可以提出不同意見，只要願意共同解決問題。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A cooperative colleague can question ideas constructively.
